subject: programmatic-seo-pages

pages.note: Each page = one card/coin/model with: title, measurement data, verification link, methodology, last-updated timestamp

sitemap.format: XML sitemap index with shards (≤50k URLs/file)

dataset_markup.note: The ONLY route into Google Dataset Search + citation by AI answer engines (Perplexity/AIO/Bing)

indexnow.note: Key file at root, POST to submit — Bing crawls within hours

rss_autodiscovery.note: Unlocks dev.to auto-import, Telegram bot, Mastodon bot, Bluesky bot

honest_sentence: 504 programmatic pages (43 cards + 425 stablecoins + 36 models). Each page = one measurement with Dataset JSON-LD markup. Sitemap + IndexNow + RSS autodiscovery = search engines find them within hours.
